fields.description: Master switch for manual rate editing on POS. When enabled, each POS Settings record can still disable rate editing for its own profile.
fields.label: Allow Editable Selling Price on POS

fields.description: When enabled, cashiers can choose a posting date during checkout and the submitted POS invoice will use that date.
fields.label: Allow Editing Posting Date on POS

fields.description: Preserve ERPNext standard role permissions when POSNext custom permissions are synced. Disable only if this site intentionally manages the complete custom permission matrix for POSNext-affected ERPNext DocTypes.
fields.label: Protect ERPNext Permissions from POSNext Overrides

fields.description: Optional future guard. Enter one role per line or comma-separated. Leave empty to allow all POS users when selling price editing is enabled.
fields.label: Editable Price Roles
